scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because the verifier cannot re-run DFT calculations; we compare the submitted final numbers to the paper's reported B3LYP/6-311G(d) values within tolerances (result-level compare).

required.SiN: object with keys re, we, T_A2Pi
required.SiN2: object with keys r_NN, r_SiN, we1, we2, we3
required.Si2N: object with keys r_SiN, we1, we2, we3

outputs.description: JSON file containing computed equilibrium bond lengths (Å), harmonic vibrational frequencies (cm⁻¹), and vertical excitation energy (cm⁻¹) for the benchmark systems. All values are floats.

output_contract.notes: The target values are the specific computed results from DFT/B3LYP/6-311G(d) and TDDFT/B3LYP/6-311G(d) as reported in the paper; the verifier compares against hidden gold values with appropriate absolute tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for B3LYP/6-311G(d) benchmark results from the paper (Tables 1, 3, 4, 6)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper tables: Table 1, Table 3, Table 4, Table 6 of the source paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's published tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper's own computed results for the exact method/basis set

steps.description: Verify all benchmark quantities match the paper's B3LYP/6-311G(d) values within tolerance
